description: Restores the PE node classifier from a commit in the pe_nc_backup repo. A real restore REPLACES THE ENTIRE NODE GROUP HIERARCHY through import-hierarchy. It runs as a dry run by default, showing which groups would be added, removed, or changed. To restore, set dry_run to false and confirm to 'replace-entire-classifier'. The live classifier is committed to the repo first, so a bad restore can be undone with this task. Run it on the PE primary server.

commit.description: The commit in the backup repo to restore, for example a commit id or HEAD~3. Defaults to HEAD.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without changing anything. Defaults to true.

confirm.description: Must be 'replace-entire-classifier' for a real restore.

max_count_drop.description: Refuse to restore if the backup has more than this percentage fewer groups than the live classifier. Defaults to 10.

force.description: Restore even if the group count drops by more than max_count_drop. The other checks still apply.

read_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the classifier to respond, including to the import. Defaults to 600.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait when connecting to the classifier. Defaults to 60.

certname.description: The primary's certname, which names its certificate and key. Defaults to puppet config print certname.

ssl_dir.description: The primary's Puppet ssl directory. Defaults to /etc/puppetlabs/puppet/ssl.

classifier_host.description: The host serving the classifier API. Defaults to the certname.

classifier_port.description: The classifier API port. Defaults to 4433.
